resources.string: A floating UP / DOWN / DNT signal checker for Binance.US spot markets. It reads public candles and never places trades.

Target-aware 15-minute decision system: each quarter-hour session uses the Binance 15-minute candle open as its baseline target. The 1-minute momentum contributes up to ±5, the aligned 5-minute trend up to ±3, and 15-minute target proximity up to ±2. UP is only allowed below the target buffer; DOWN is only allowed above it. The buffer is the greater of 0.05% of the target or one quarter of recent 15-minute ATR. No new entries are allowed during the final 2 minutes of a session. Each qualifying signal opens a 60-second entry window. This is a manual decision aid, not financial advice or an automatic trader.
